ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the entire ventral surface with a high macro-contrast ratio against the overexposed background; internal white-to-black pixel ratio is approximately 0.05:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid black pigmentation across the majority of the fluke area, punctuated by sparse, high-intensity white circular ring-like blobs distributed across both lateral lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 40 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of approximately 10% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, varying-amplitude serrations; pixel-level peaks and valleys are continuous from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Geometric curve following an upward and outward trajectory with localized convexity in the mid-lobe regions and slight concavity approaching the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white rings forming a non-uniform constellation across the central and outer ventral surfaces of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, parallel diagonal linear pixel disruptions detectable on the image-right lobe, cutting through the primary black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of high-intensity white pixel formations concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes and along portions of the visible leading edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a turbulent water-air interface at the base of the fluke, masking the lower central fluke-to-peduncle transition.
